notes.title: Gamepad Hotfix vol.2
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers,

We're back with another small fix:

Changed default keybinding for Janka's Wall Climbing from (X) to Right Trigger Button.

This change also aligns with the full version of the game, where the trigger is used for wall climbing as well.

Oh, and yes - Janosik 2 is now out! Check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640400/Janosik_2/

Enjoy!

notes.title: Verified Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183325/c61f6905c607713ca92c59d275f354ca2450c2e3.png

Hello adventurers,

We're excited to let you all know that Janosik 2: Prologue is now Steam Deck Verified! You can now take Janka with you anywhere you go, and continue your adventures on your commute, at school, work, or you can even visit Slovakian Highlands while venturing through pixel-art highlands!

We've also prepared a couple of fixes that have been reported by the players. Here they are:
 Fixed a bug that caused pause menu to pop up when entering Level 3
 Added extra doors to make it easier to get out of the underwater level. We've received a report from a player who  went in without the underwater breathing skill and had a hard time getting back, that should no longer be a case!
Stay awesome, and keep playing Janosik 2: Prologue. Thank you for all review so far, and if you haven't left one yet, make sure to do so as it helps us reach even more players!

Wishlist Janosik 2:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640400/Janosik_2/

notes.title: Gamepad Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers,

In the previous patch, we fixed a bug that prevented some players from jumping down through platforms. However, that fix eliminated the problem only for players using a keyboard, not a gamepad.

In this hotfix, we're addressing the issue for gamepad users as well.

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Powers Unlocked - Janosik 2: Prologue Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers,

First off, we'd like to thank you for the warm welcome Janosik 2: Prologue has received. We're happy to see you enjoy Janka's story, and we can't wait for to get Janosik 2 out to you all. Many adventures are ahead of you, as we're just getting started.

We've prepared a couple of improvements for the Prologue, as well as a fix for a bug that players reported.

Patch Notes

- Added "Character Skills" option to the menu - it allows you to see what abilities Janka posseses and which of them are unlocked.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183325/4d5da6d68dd34d3e1f2dd4175da51a9e907476cb.png
- Added 2 new upgrades : Renew All Hearts and Fire Lamp

Renew All Hearts can be found in the "Frosty Lands" level, and it causes you to refill all hearts upon respawning.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183325/c8f86b69bcd3eec47e9e2dc0dedc1cef6d613c69.png
Fire Lamp can be found in the "Underwater" level. It shoots fire projectiles which set enemies ablaze.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183325/432113f7e57ccf7ba4f205718ce29ec5a91450b9.png
- Reduced the number of water/swimming segments in the first level

- Fixed a bug that caused some players to be unable to jump down through platforms

That's all the changes for today - if you'd like to share your feedback, or if you've found a bug, please make sure to let us know on the Steam Forum or our Discord server.

If you like Janosik 2: Prologue, please share it with your friends and leave a Steam review to help us reach even more players.

And don’t forget to wishlist Janosik 2:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640400/Janosik_2/

notes.title: Janosik 2: Prologue Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're excited to announce that Janosik 2: Prologue will release in just a few days, on October 1st. 

In this prelude to the main game, you'll step into the shoes of Janka, as she faces off against the cunning Baron de Blonde. This standalone adventure features 8 challenging levels filled with tricky enemies and environmental obstacles. Get ready to uncover the events leading up to Janosik’s dramatic encounter with Bathory's goons!

Janosik 2: Prologue will soon be available for free download on Steam.

Don't forget to wishlist and follow Janosik 2: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640400/Janosik_2/

notes.title: Dev Update: A Tale of the Brave Maiden
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

If you watched Janosik 2's trailer, you're probably familiar with the scene of Janosik blissfully running towards Janka, only to find out it's a trap and fall into the hands of Countess Bathory... But what led to that dramatic twist? That's where Janosik 2: Prologue comes in.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/fab0e78abe737a5824f39fdadca46438e083547e.gif

Set directly before the events of the main game, the prologue serves as a prelude to the unforgettable adventure awaiting Janosik. This time, you take on the role of Janka, Janosik's sweetheart, as she gets read for what was supposed to be a wonderful date with her boyfriend. However, her plans are rudely interrupted by the cunning Baron de Blonde, acting on behalf of the devious Countess Bathory, 

In this bite-sized adventure you'll guide Janka through 8 challenging levels filled with tricky enemies, enviromental obstacles, and hidden secrets. As you progress through the prologue, Baba Yaga, who runs a magical shop filled with powerful upgrades, will help you learn how to freeze enemies, double jump, dash through the air, or scale walls without breaking a sweat. Each ability not only helps Janka overcome future challenges but also opens up new pathways and secrets in areas you've already explored.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/21bcf625feb638647918b3bf51db09bcab986b22.gif

Janosik 2: Prologue is more than just a teaser; it’s a full-fledged adventure on its own. A true prologue, one might say, as it gives you a unique chance to experience Janka’s side of the story and see what led to Janosik’s unfortunate encounter with Countess Bathory's goons.

Wishlist Janosik 2: Prologue. Coming Soon!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2945900/Janosik_2_Prologue/

Upcoming Open Steam Playtest
We're happy to announce the upcoming Open Steam Playtest for Janosik 2. On Monday, September 16, we'll enable the option to sign up for playtest on the game's Steam Page. All you'll have to do is just click "Request Access" button to automatically add a Playtest application to your Steam library.

During this playtest you will be able to play the first couple of levels of Janosik 2, and let us know what you think about the game. On Monday we will post a link to the feedback survey, which is the best way for us to assess your feelings about the game, and we will also open dedicated sections in the Steam forums for the playtest.

The Playtest will last for a week, and will end on Monday, September 23. We hope to see as many of you as possible in there.

Another Playtest!
Next week, we’ll not only be playtesting Janosik 2, but also Undead West, another upcoming title from Retrovibe. It’s a roguelite bullet-hell filled with guns, whiskey, and tons of action, Check it out on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527880/Undead_West/

Make sure to join our Discord server to become a part of our Community and stay up to date with all things Janosik. 

Until next time!
